title: 第三十一章 暮风锁台清梵镇蛟铃第三十三章 夜馆私语八强遇旧敌
lines: 日头西沉，残阳染血。
整片永安郡中央比武台，被一层暗沉橘红暮色笼罩。
天边流云被落日浸成暗红，风过十丈青石擂台，卷起地面残留的黑色煞尘，漫天浮沉，落地便蚀出细碎白点，那是方才擒蛟煞阵消散后，遗留不散的域外残煞。
第二轮对决落幕，倒地的冥阁死士烬夜被黑衣属下无声抬离擂台。
自始至终，烬夜空洞双目没有一丝情绪，落败如同既定程序，败了，便退场，毫无波澜。这就是冥阁养大的死士，无喜无悲，生死皆由阁主一念而定，从出生起，便是为猎杀而生。
看台喧嚣，渐渐压下沉寂。
晚风转凉，暮气沉沉压下全场，观战武者尽数敛声，心底的躁动亢奋，尽数被一股无形寒意压住。
两轮对局，看得所有人脊背发凉。
从黑石城厉骁借阵强攻，到冥阁烬夜开阵锁脉，步步都是死局，招招直指沈砚性命。可这名青阳城来的少年，以武徒三重之身，破煞、斩死士、扛武师隔空威压，硬生生从两轮必死之局里，踏血取胜。
擂台上，青衫边角破碎，肩头皮肉溃烂结痂，淡黑煞痕嵌在肌理之间，久久无法消退。
沈砚垂眸，指尖捻开周清鸢递来的净煞灵液，瓷瓶开盖一瞬，一缕温润纯白灵气散开，刚好克制周身阴煞。灵液涂抹伤口，灼烧痛感瞬间褪去，腐蚀破损的皮肉，以肉眼可见的速度收口愈合。
残留经脉滞涩之感，一扫而空。
“冥阁不会就此收手。”
白衣周清鸢立身身侧，晚风拂动她鬓边碎发，玉柄长剑斜垂地面，眸光望向西侧清风宗看台，声线压得极低，只有二人可闻，“方才高楼夜衍传音清风宗，下一轮出战之人，是清风宗少宗主，楚凌。”
沈砚抬眸，视线越过层层看台，精准落在清风宗贵宾席位。
清风宗坐落永安郡南麓，宗门主修清心梵力，灵力至纯至正，天生克制一切兽类血脉、邪异骨力，恰好与碧鳞蛟血脉天生相克。
席位正中，白衣束冠少年端坐，眉眼温润斯文，气质不染烟火，看似温润如玉，眼底却藏着极深的漠然冷意。
楚凌，清风宗百年第一天骄，武徒三重巅峰修为，底蕴远超厉骁、烬夜，同辈之内，极少出手，出手必分生死。
“不止修为。”周清鸢眉心微蹙，氛围感凝重几分，红唇轻启道出底牌，“楚凌随身携带宗门古物，三阶灵宝，清梵镇蛟铃。此铃出土于镇蛟古遗迹，专门镇压水系蛟类血脉，铃音一响，蛟脉蛰伏封印，你所有血脉力量、肉身鳞甲，都会被强行封禁。”
最致命的克制，迎面而来。
之前对战，沈砚最大底牌便是蛟鳞肉身、本源煞力豁免，可遇上镇蛟灵宝，底牌直接作废，等同于被废一半战力。
没有鳞甲护体，没有血脉破煞，他只剩功法身法，直面顶尖宗门天骄。
“我知晓了。”
沈砚淡淡应声，神色不见慌乱。
从踏入郡城擂台那日起，他就清楚，这一场盛会，从来不是公平比武，是冥阁量身打造的猎蛟棋局。棋局之内，棋子轮番上场，杀招层层叠加，目的只有一个——活捉或者斩杀自己。
躲不开，退不得。
退赛，便失去郡守庇护，日后冥阁可明目张胆全境追杀，阿禾、侯府一众善待他之人，都会被牵连清算。
只能迎难而上。
“你的蛟脉，不可催动。一旦铃音入体，血脉彻底封禁，短时间无法解封，后续决赛，再无翻盘余地。”周清鸢最后叮嘱一句，抬脚缓步走回贵宾席，白衣背影消融在暮色晚风里。
她能破一次阵法，能提点一次危机，却不能直接下场帮战。
郡守府制衡全郡，一旦公然偏袒沈砚，会被扣上徇私坏规的名头，得罪清风宗、冥阁两大势力，郡城格局直接崩塌。
高台之上，司仪嗓音略显干涩，穿透暮风传开：“二轮结束，休整一刻钟，第三轮抽签开赛！剩余武者不足二十人，本轮对决，直接敲定八强席位！”
暮风呼啸，吹得擂台旗帜猎猎作响。
侯府看台角落，阿禾紧紧攥紧拳头，指尖泛白，满眼焦灼望向擂台青衫身影，低声自语：“清风宗镇蛟灵宝，专门克制公子血脉，这一战太难了……”
执法长老秦守伫立一旁，面色沉郁。
他方才已经探查清楚，楚凌梵力醇厚干净，功法克制碎云诀，外加灵宝加持，天时地利人和，尽数站在楚凌一方。
“实在不敌，便可主动认输，保住性命为重。”秦守隔空传音，语气带着无奈，“输掉擂台无妨，我拼尽全力，也可保你平安离开郡城。”
沈砚收到传音，只是轻轻摇头，没有回应。
认输容易，可认输之后，前路万丈荆棘，无人可替他挡。
content_en:
The sun is setting in the west, and the setting sun is stained with blood.
The entire Yong'an County Central Competition Arena was shrouded in a layer of dark orange-red twilight.
The clouds in the sky were soaked into dark red by the setting sun. The wind passed over the ten-foot-long bluestone arena, picking up the remaining black evil dust on the ground and floating all over the sky. When it hit the ground, it was eroded into tiny white spots. These were the residual evil spirits from outside the territory that were left behind after the dragon capture array dissipated just now.
The second round of the showdown came to an end, and Jin Ye, the fallen warrior of Ming Pavilion, was silently carried away from the ring by his subordinates in black.
From the beginning to the end, Jin Ye's empty eyes were devoid of any emotion. Defeat was just like the established procedure. After defeat, he left the game without any disturbance. This is the dead man raised by Ming Pavilion. He has no joy or sorrow. His life and death are determined by the thought of the pavilion master. From birth, he is born for hunting.
The din in the stands gradually subsided into silence.
The evening breeze turned cooler, and a heavy twilight air descended on the entire audience. All the warriors watching the battle suppressed their voices, and all the restlessness and excitement in their hearts were suppressed by an invisible chill.
The two rounds of competition sent shivers down everyone's spine.
From Black Rock City where Li Xiao borrowed the formation to attack, to Ming Pavilion Jinye opening the formation to lock the pulse, every step was a dead end, with every move aimed at Shen Yan's life. But this young man from Qingyang City, with the third level of a martial arts disciple, can destroy evil spirits, kill dead soldiers, and bear the pressure of martial arts from a distance, and he can forcefully win from two rounds of inevitable death situations.
On the ring, the edges of the green shirt were torn, the flesh on the shoulders was festered and scabbed, and dark black marks were embedded in the texture, which could not fade away for a long time.
Shen Yan lowered his eyes and twisted the evil-purifying spiritual liquid handed over by Zhou Qingyuan with his fingertips. The moment the porcelain bottle was opened, a wisp of warm and pure white spiritual energy spread out, just enough to restrain the evil spirits all over his body. When the spiritual liquid is applied to the wound, the burning pain disappears instantly, corroding the damaged skin and healing it at a speed visible to the naked eye.
The remaining feeling of stagnation in the meridians is swept away.
"Mingge will not stop here."
Zhou Qingyuan in white clothes stood beside her, the evening breeze ruffled her hair on the temples, her long sword with a jade handle hung diagonally on the ground, her eyes looked towards the Qingfeng Sect stand to the west, her voice was very low, only two people could hear, "Just now Gaolou Yeyan sent a message to the Qingfeng Sect, the person who will fight in the next round is the young master of the Qingfeng Sect, Chu Ling."
Shen Yan raised his eyes, looked across the stands, and landed precisely on the VIP seats of Qingfeng Sect.
The Qingfeng Sect is located at the southern foot of Yong'an County. The sect specializes in the Pure Heart Brahma Power. Its spiritual power is extremely pure and righteous. It is naturally capable of restraining all animal bloodlines and evil bone powers. It is naturally incompatible with the Blue Scale Dragon bloodline.
In the middle of the seat, a young man in white clothes and a crown sat upright. His eyebrows were gentle and gentle, and his temperament was not stained by fireworks. He seemed as gentle as jade, but there was a deep indifference hidden in his eyes.
Chu Ling, the Qingfeng Sect's number one genius in a hundred years, was a third-level martial arts disciple at the peak of his cultivation. His foundation far surpassed that of Li Xiao and Jin Ye. Among his peers, he rarely took action, and any action would mean the difference between life and death.
"It's not just about cultivation." Zhou Qingyuan's brows furrowed slightly, and the atmosphere became more solemn. She opened her red lips and revealed her trump card, "Chu Ling carries with him the ancient artifacts of the sect, the third-level spiritual treasure, and the Qingfan Zhen Jiao Bell. This bell was unearthed from the ancient ruins of Zhen Jiao. It is specially designed to suppress the water dragon bloodline. When the bell rings, the dragon veins are dormant and sealed. All your bloodline power and physical scales will be forcibly sealed."
The most deadly restraint is coming.
In the previous battle, Shen Yan's biggest trump card was the dragon scale body and immunity from the original evil force. However, when encountering the dragon-suppressing spirit treasure, the trump card was directly invalidated, which was equivalent to losing half of his combat power.
Without scale armor to protect his body, and no bloodline to break evil spirits, he only had his skills and body skills to face the top sect's genius.
"I understand."
Shen Yan responded calmly, without any panic in his expression.
From the day he stepped into the county arena, he knew that this grand event was never a fair competition, but a dragon hunting chess game tailor-made by Ming Pavilion. Within the chess game, the chess pieces take turns to play, and the killing moves are piled up layer by layer. There is only one purpose - to capture or kill oneself alive.
Can't hide, can't retreat.
If he withdraws from the competition, he will lose the protection of the county guard. In the future, Ming Pavilion will be able to blatantly pursue him throughout the country, and everyone in Ahe and Hou Mansion who treated him well will be implicated and liquidated.
We can only face the difficulties head on.
"Don't activate your dragon veins. Once the sound of the bell enters the body, the blood veins are completely blocked and cannot be unblocked for a short period of time. There will be no room for a comeback in the subsequent finals." Zhou Qingyuan gave the last instruction, raised his feet and walked slowly back to the VIP seat, his white-clothed back melting into the evening breeze.
She can break a formation and raise a crisis, but she can't directly join the fight.
The county governor's office checks and balances the whole county. Once he openly favors Shen Yan, he will be accused of being a favoritist and violating the rules. He will offend the two major forces of Qingfeng Sect and Ming Pavilion, and the structure of the county will directly collapse.
On the high platform, the emcee's voice was slightly dry, and it spread through the dusk wind: "The second round is over, after a quarter of an hour's rest, the third round of drawing begins! There are less than twenty warriors left. This round of duel, the top eight seats will be determined directly!"
The dusk wind howled, making the ring flags ring.
In the corner of the stands of the Hou Mansion, Ah He clenched his fists tightly, his fingertips turned white, and looked at the figure in blue shirt on the stage with anxious eyes, and whispered to himself: "Qingfeng Sect suppresses Jiao Lingbao, specializing in restraining the young master's bloodline. This battle is too difficult..."
Law enforcement elder Qin Shou stood aside with a gloomy expression.
He had just found out that Chu Ling's Fan Power was mellow and clean, his skills restrained the Shattering Cloud Technique, and he was blessed with spiritual treasures. The right time, place, and people were all on Chu Ling's side.
"If you are really defeated, you can take the initiative to admit defeat. Saving your life is the most important thing." Qin Shou said through the air, with a helpless tone, "It doesn't matter if you lose in the arena. I will try my best to ensure that you leave the county safely."
When Shen Yan received the message, he just shook his head slightly and did not respond.
It is easy to admit defeat, but after admitting defeat, the road ahead will be full of thorns and no one can stop him.
